# Rules

<!-- Generated by `python -m kernel.docs_plane --write` from docs/rules.yaml; do not edit by hand. -->

Rulebook version **5.0**. One rule per row; every rule cites the decisions it comes from and names what enforces it (a code or test the gate runs, or `protocol` for a rule the agent follows). No two rules contradict; a later decision changes a rule only through a new version of this file.

## How agents work

| Rule | Statement | Source | Enforced by |
|---|---|---|---|
| R-01 | Read AGENTS.md, the five indexes and docs/plan.md before touching anything; refresh and query graft and graphify before reading files. | ADR-S6, ADR-O64 | protocol |
| R-02 | One slice per commit, committed only when scripts/verify.sh exits 0. | ADR-O5, ADR-O67 | .githooks/pre-commit, .github/workflows/verify.yml |
| R-03 | Nothing is pushed without the owner's word; a finish run the owner started has that word for each slice that clears its gate, its self-audit and the hygiene scan. | ADR-O5, ADR-O101, ADR-O107 | protocol |
| R-04 | Claude never renders and never calls a paid model API; authored steps are written in-session from a sealed packet. | ADR-S2, ADR-O40 | protocol, compiler/authoring.py packet hash check |
| R-05 | Predict the outcome before each check and report whether it held. | ADR-S4 | protocol |
| R-06 | Ask the owner only where the DAG, these rules or the decisions are silent or contradict; write the question as a finding (type question) and wait instead of guessing. A finish run answers it from the plan's own sources as an owner_default ADR for the owner to confirm, unless the answer would set aside an owner ruling or an owner invariant; that question waits. | ADR-S4, ADR-O64, ADR-O101, ADR-O107 | protocol |
| R-07 | Log every schema, library card, kernel file and frozen doc change in its hash log; a frozen doc change also bumps its docs-version. | ADR-S1, ADR-O64 | kernel.schema_log verify (schemas, library, kernel, docs) |
| R-08 | Never edit authored data silently: scripts derive and refuse; a content change is an owner-decided, recorded deviation. | ADR-O39, ADR-O26 | compiler/rebind.py packet hashes, tests/test_reference_fight_golden.py |
| R-09 | Never edit kernel/layer_order.yaml or the golden by hand: a change needs an accepted ADR, its log entry and a version bump; examples are rewritten only by python -m compiler.examples --write. | ADR-O4, ADR-O59, ADR-S1 | kernel.schema_log verify (kernel), python -m compiler.examples (byte check) |
| R-10 | Place every check at the first step that can see its data (docs/layer_order.md); a fix lives in the layer that owns the data. | ADR-O61, ADR-O4 | protocol, validators/layer_dependency_validator.py WRITE_SCOPE |
| R-11 | Test the uncertain, build the certain: a change gets a render probe only if it is uncertain, visual and not verifiable without a render. | ADR-O46 | protocol |
| R-31 | Before asking the owner to commit or push, run the self-audit (docs/prompts/self_audit.md) and report its verdict, evidence table and wrong claims. | ADR-O68 | protocol, .claude/commands/self-audit.md |
| R-32 | Log every decision the plan did not spell out in the session file's Decisions section, with the rule, ruling or DAG row behind it, the alternatives and what it affects; a choice no rule or ruling makes is labelled as an interpretation or proposed as an ADR. | ADR-O70 | protocol, docs/prompts/autopilot.md |
| R-33 | A slice may rewrite the examples so they pass its own new check, as recorded deviations (the golden test and the session file), without a ruling per change. | ADR-O75 | protocol, docs/prompts/autopilot.md |
| R-34 | A check that judges a whole-body quality (direction, lean, height, momentum) reads the root's rotation, the support and every joint it depends on, and skips a span it cannot judge (an airborne turn) instead of reporting it. | ADR-O76 | protocol |
| R-12 | Never paper over a failure: when the verifier fails, fix or revert, and record what went wrong in the plan or a finding. | ADR-O64 | protocol |

## What the compiler guarantees

| Rule | Statement | Source | Enforced by |
|---|---|---|---|
| R-13 | The step IDs carry the build order: a step reads only what earlier steps wrote and writes only its own paths. | ADR-O4, ADR-F2 | validators/layer_dependency_validator.py check_layer_order, WRITE_SCOPE |
| R-14 | Every layer that produces state has nodes and edges; L0, L0.5, L6 and L6.5 have nodes only; L4d facial runs for live action and UGC only. | ADR-O58, ADR-O57 | kernel/layer_order.yaml (reviewed; no code check yet) |
| R-15 | Contracts are JSON Schemas checked by the in-repo validator; no Pydantic; pyyaml is the only runtime dependency. | ADR-O30 | tests/test_schemas.py, uv.lock |
| R-16 | The repo is model-agnostic and built for Seedance: no model cards; models arrive later as adapters (M7). | ADR-O49, ADR-B3 | protocol |
| R-17 | Where the golden contradicts its own words or the DAG, fix the golden as a recorded deviation; where a new check fails on internally consistent golden content, fix the check. | ADR-O59, ADR-O26 | tests/test_reference_fight_golden.py |
| R-18 | Bodies and props obey the scene's physics: no teleport above 25 m/s except a declared substitution; props follow gravity unless a float is declared (anime only). | ADR-O8, ADR-O12 | TELEPORT, PROP_KINEMATICS |
| R-35 | Hip angles are read from the trunk (the root, then Sp) in every key, genre and example: forward kinematics hangs the legs from the spine, and every authored key writes its hips that way. | ADR-O84, ADR-S7 | solver/forward_kinematics.py, planner/prompts/euler_solving.txt, tests/test_forward_kinematics.py |

## What every prompt must say

| Rule | Statement | Source | Enforced by |
|---|---|---|---|
| R-19 | A prompt is a deliverable only when every applicable DAG-map row passes on it, shown per prompt; NOT CHECKED is not a pass. | ADR-S3, ADR-O13 | validators/checklist.py, examples/*/checklist.md |
| R-20 | The format comes from the DAG's own instances (D6, D9, D10). | ADR-S7, ADR-O19 | validators/prompt_validator.py SECTION_ORDER, STAFF_FORMAT |
| R-21 | No hold, freeze or pause is written in frames; a hit gets a camera hold with the bodies in frame and no close-up. | ADR-O47 | BODY_HOLD_FRAMES |
| R-22 | A hand that releases a prop and then holds nothing is said to be empty. | ADR-O47 | EMPTY_HAND_UNSTATED |
| R-23 | A turn is named once by axis, plane and count, with takeoff and landing; no angles at times, no rates, no angles on the lines inside it. | ADR-O47, ADR-O33 | ROTATION_ANGLES_PRINTED, TURN_LABEL |
| R-24 | No prop is called hidden or not visible; an object the scene needs later stands in the scene from the start and the prompt says where. | ADR-O48 | HIDDEN_PHRASING |
| R-25 | Every causal link prints a reason that states a cause. | ADR-O15 | CAUSE_REASON |
| R-26 | Every stated count agrees with the scene. | ADR-O17 | COUNT_CONTRADICTION |
| R-27 | Effort actions stay Laban (punch = thrust); combat verbs go on contacts. | ADR-O22 | EFFORT_VOCABULARY, CONTACT_VERB, renderers/prose_renderer.py |

## What only the owner does

| Rule | Statement | Source | Enforced by |
|---|---|---|---|
| R-28 | Only the owner accepts a decision; an agent proposal not objected to is recorded as owner_default. | ADR-O64, ADR-O67 | docs/decisions/ Decided By field |
| R-29 | Only the owner renders and gives render verdicts; verdicts are logged word for word, Claude's frame notes apart. | ADR-S5, ADR-O56 | docs/renders/ Owner Verdict field |
| R-30 | Only the owner approves a push, a card leaving draft and a change to the layer order or the golden; in a finish run that approval stands for each slice's push and for golden changes recorded as deviations under ADR-O102. | ADR-O5, ADR-S1, ADR-O102, ADR-O107 | protocol, .github/CODEOWNERS |
